FN-TB27795-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 278
Committee: Health Sponsor: Representative Phillip Rigsby
Analyst: Tiffany Weaver Date: 02/17/2025
House Bill 278 as introduced would increase the administrative obligations of the State Board
of Pharmacy to adopt rules to implement the provisions of this bill. This bill would not
otherwise directly affect state or local funding.
